digest.component_or_area: CLI command retirement and schema cleanup
propositions: The file-backed bridge-status handler and purge-bridge implementations were removed in change 1517 and must remain absent from the codebase.
The hidden bridge-status compatibility alias must route only to canonical durable bridge status and not appear in top-level help.
All schema registry exports of BRIDGE_STATUS and output-schema entries for bridge-status must be removed along with their JSON schema files.
Both bridge-status and purge-bridge commands must exit as unknown commands and be absent from help, CLI reference docs, and active documentation.
Surviving bridge alert warnings in reads_cli.py and output.py must provide neutral guidance without referencing retired or unshipped commands.
The CHANGELOG.md must document both command retirements as part of the release notes.
